# MARVEN

> MARVEN is a futuristic mystery video editor creating cinematic TikTok edits, creator reels, LIVE host edits, and promotional videos.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://marven.de5.net/): The main website with all information about MARVEN, including the editing system, wallpapers,Maya, and live signals.
- [Contact](https://marven.de5.net/#contact): How to get in touch with MARVEN for collaborations.

## About

- [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@marveneditz): Official TikTok account for MARVEN.
